mapper.select: SELECT t1.GIJUN_YMD , t1.CURRENCY , t1.GIJUN_RT , t1.TRANS_RT , t1.IP_YMD , t1.CROSS_RATE , t1.CROSS_CURRENCY , F_CURRENCY_GB(t1.CURRENCY) AS currency_gb FROM SYX0HY t1 WHERE t1.GIJUN_YMD = #{ymd} AND t1.CURRENCY != 'KRW' ORDER BY F_CURRENCY_SORT(t1.CURRENCY)

SELECT t1.GIJUN_YMD , t1.GIJUN_RT , t1.TRANS_RT , NVL(t1.GIJUN_RT, 0) - LAG(t1.GIJUN_RT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.CURRENCY, t1.GIJUN_YMD) AS gijun , NVL(t1.TRANS_RT, 0) - LAG(t1.TRANS_RT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.CURRENCY, t1.GIJUN_YMD) AS trans FROM SYX0HY t1 WHERE t1.GIJUN_YMD BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{ymd}, -3) AND #{ymd} AND t1.CURRENCY = #{currency} ORDER BY t1.GIJUN_YMD DESC
